summary: Allow the existing Owner PWA issuer to tolerate up to five seconds of CLI clock skew and reject authorization older than five minutes; preserve the 20-minute expiry, one-use transaction, firmware mutation closure, and exact scope.

evidence.reason: The issuer compared the owner timestamp for exact floating-point equality with a later CLI time.time() call, so a fresh existing authorization could not be issued through its normal command.
evidence.rollback: Revert the admission issuer timestamp comparison in scripts/hbnf_control.py; no production/device state changes are required.
